title: E-invoice Matching with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Ready for processing and business impact

features.name: E-invoice Matching with Copilot
features.description: Copilot analyzes electronic invoices and automatically compares line items with purchase orders, performing intelligent matching to reduce manual effort in invoice processing.
caveats: Requires electronic documents to be set up in the system
Discrepancies within user-defined tolerance levels are signaled but require review

features.name: Discrepancy Detection and Tolerance Levels
features.description: Copilot signals discrepancies that fall within user-controlled tolerance levels and identifies when line items may be split or grouped differently.
caveats: Tolerance levels must be configured by users
Split or grouped items require manual review

features.name: Vendor Document Updates
features.description: Business Central automatically updates the vendor document number and date after invoice mapping is completed, preparing the invoice for processing.

quotes.text: tediously matching line items is not how you want to start your workday
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the pain point that Copilot solves - manual invoice matching is time-consuming and error-prone

quotes.text: using powerful AI co-pilot analyzes the E invoice and compares the line items with your purchase order getting you to Green in no time
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core capability - automatic comparison of invoice lines to purchase orders with quick resolution

quotes.text: co-pilot also signals slight discrepancies that are within the tolerance levels that you control
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that tolerance levels are configurable by users, giving them control over what requires manual intervention

quotes.text: even if you're dealing with dozens or perhaps hundreds of lines co-pilot also signals slight discrepancies
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the solution scales to handle high-volume invoices with many line items

quotes.text: after a quick review this invoice is successfully mapped and ready to apply to the purchase order
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the workflow - Copilot proposes matching, then user confirms before final processing
